title: 第7章 梦境第8章 遗憾第9章 目标
slug: 我在玄幻世界召唤奇物
content_zh:
云梦城，外城，朝阳坊。
位于朝阳坊角落的位置，新开了一家名叫“黄粱一梦”的店铺。
没有什么开业仪式，也没有什么吆喝，光看名字，你都不知道他是卖什么的。
不过这也引起了其他人的好奇，好奇这个店铺是卖什么的，怎么取了黄粱一梦这个名字。
此时一胖一瘦两个身影站在了门前，瘦子看着头上的匾额嘀咕道：“老李，你说这家店铺是做啥的啊？”
李大海看着身旁的孙千：“我哪知道啊，要不进去看看？反正都是街坊邻居的，之后免不了接触，现在先了解下？”
孙千点了点头：“有道理，那走，进去瞧瞧。”
说完两人就迈步走进店铺，映入眼帘的是躺在躺椅上闭目养神的青年，看面相二十来岁，剑眉星目，细皮嫩肉的，一身黑衣，看起来就跟出来游玩的贵公子一样，就是头发太短了，显得有些怪异。
似乎是听到两人的脚步声，齐源睁开双眼，看向两人，一胖一瘦，齐源差点还以为是胖瘦头陀呢。
李大海对着齐源说道：“这位小哥，你家掌柜呢，我们是隔壁铺子的掌柜，今天看到有店铺开张，特来恭贺。”
齐源对着两人微微一笑，拱手道：“两位老哥好，我就是这家店铺掌柜。”
李大海跟孙千听闻一愣，仔细打量了下齐源然后说道：“真是人不可貌相啊，小兄弟年纪轻轻就开了家店铺，实在是长江后浪推前浪啊。”
孙千附和道：“是啊，是啊，想当初我两也都是年快四十了，才勉强开了家店铺为生。”
“两位掌柜客气了，来，这边坐。”齐源摆了摆手，然后领着两人到一处桌子旁坐下，倒了杯茶给两人。
“谢过两位掌柜今天来道贺，本来没打算办什么开业仪式的，所以也就没有准备什么吃的，还请两位海涵。”
李大海跟孙千对视一眼哈哈一笑：“无妨，是我们两人不请自来，我们只是想看看新开的店铺是做什么的，顺便认识一下，邻里街坊的，之后有什么事情也好照应一下。”
“对啊，不知道小哥怎么称呼。”
说完还没等齐源介绍，李大海已经介绍上了，李大海指了指孙千说道：“他叫孙千，你叫他孙哥就好了，开裁缝铺的，就在你隔壁。
平时要是需要什么衣服，尽管找他，我跟你说，他这手艺可好了，整个外城，就数他手艺最好了。”
孙千连忙谦虚道：“别听老李瞎说，不过要是需要衣服，尽管来找我，我还是会点手艺的。”

齐源点头：“好的孙哥，有需要的话一定找你。”
说完李大海开始了自我介绍：“我叫李大海，你叫我李哥就好了，我是开药材铺的，也负责看点小毛病，要是需要药材或者看病，来找我！”
“好的，李哥，我叫齐源，这两天才来云梦城，往后还需要两位大哥照顾一二。”
李大海两人点头笑道：“好说，好说，那我们就叫你齐兄弟了。”
content_en:
Yunmeng City, Outer City, Chaoyangfang.
Located at the corner of Chaoyangfang, a new store called "Huangliang Yimeng" has opened.
There was no opening ceremony and no shouting. Just by looking at the name, you wouldn’t know what it sells.
However, this also aroused the curiosity of others, wondering what this store sells and why it got the name Huangliang Yimeng.
At this time, two figures, one fat and one thin, stood in front of the door. The thin man looked at the plaque above his head and muttered: "Old Li, what do you think this shop is for?"
Li Dahai looked at Sun Qian beside him: "How do I know? Why don't you go in and take a look? They are all neighbors anyway, and we will inevitably come into contact with them in the future. Let's get to know each other first?"
Sun Qian nodded: "It makes sense, let's go in and take a look."
After saying that, the two of them walked into the shop. What they saw was a young man lying on a recliner with his eyes closed and concentrating. He looked about twenty years old, with sharp eyebrows and starry eyes, thin skin and tender flesh. He was dressed in black. He looked like a noble man out for fun, but his hair was too short, which made him look a little weird.
As if hearing the footsteps of the two people, Qi Yuan opened his eyes and looked at the two people. One was fat and the other was thin. Qi Yuan almost thought they were fat and thin Toutuo.
Li Dahai said to Qi Yuan: "Brother, where is your shopkeeper? We are the shopkeepers of the shop next door. We saw a shop opening today, so we came here to congratulate you."
Qi Yuan smiled slightly at the two of them, cupped his hands and said, "Hello, brothers, I am the manager of this shop."
Li Dahai and Sun Qian were stunned when they heard this. They looked at Qi Yuan carefully and said, "You really can't tell by appearance. This little brother opened a shop at a young age. It's really like the waves behind the Yangtze River push the waves ahead."
Sun Qian echoed: "Yes, yes, I think we were almost forty back then, so we barely opened a shop to make a living."
"You two shopkeepers are welcome, come and sit here." Qi Yuan waved his hand, then led the two of them to sit down at a table and poured them a cup of tea.
"Thank you to the two shopkeepers for coming to congratulate me today. I didn't plan to hold any opening ceremony, so I didn't prepare anything to eat. I also invited you two Haihan."
Li Dahai and Sun Qian looked at each other and laughed: "It doesn't matter, we are here uninvited. We just want to see what the newly opened store does, and get to know the neighbors so that we can take care of anything in the future."
"Yeah, I don't know what to call him."
Before Qi Yuan could introduce him, Li Dahai had already introduced him. Li Dahai pointed at Sun Qian and said, "His name is Sun Qian. You can just call him Brother Sun. He runs a tailor shop right next door to you.
If you need any clothes at ordinary times, just go to him. Let me tell you, his craftsmanship is very good. He has the best craftsmanship in the entire outer city. "
Sun Qian quickly said modestly: "Don't listen to Lao Li's nonsense, but if you need clothes, just come to me, I can still do some craftsmanship."
Qi Yuan nodded: "Okay, Brother Sun, I will definitely come to you if I need anything."
After speaking, Li Dahai began to introduce himself: "My name is Li Dahai. You can just call me Brother Li. I run a medicine shop and I am also responsible for looking after minor illnesses. If you need medicine or medical treatment, come to me!"
"Okay, Brother Li, my name is Qi Yuan. I have only come to Yunmeng City these two days. I will need the two elder brothers to take care of me in the future."
Li Dahai and Li Dahai nodded and said with a smile: "Easy to say, easy to say, then we will call you Brother Qi."
